messages:
Priya Shah: opened PR to tighten audit webhook examples, add a Terraform-enabled retention snippet, and show an export+redaction workflow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980
Elena Kaur: can you paste the final minimal payload you plan to ship in docs? SOC2 reviewers want no raw PII in examples.
Priya Shah: sure payload in PR:
```json
{
  "event_action": "workspace.create",
  "tenant_id": "t-2026",
  "timestamp": "2026-06-10T15:30:00Z",
  "actor": { "role": "user", "pseudonym_id": "pid-7f8g" },
  "attributes": { "device_location": "[redacted]", "ip": "[redacted]" }
}
```
Notes: pseudonym_id used everywhere, device_location/ip show redacted in examples.
Tom Liu: I'll update the Go and Java SDK examples to parse "event_action" and "pseudonym_id". Also adding a tiny migration helper that accepts the legacy key audit_action for 45 days and emits X-Deprecation-Warning.
Chloe Nguyen: I added a Terraform snippet so infra teams can pin retention at deployment time. Here's the suggested example (in the PR):
```hcl
resource "redwood_audit_retention" "default" {
  tenant_id = "t-2026"
  retention_days = 90
  legal_hold = false
}
```
Docs will include a sentence that contracts can override retention.
Legal - Compliance: Wording guidance: "Default retention for audit records is 90 days (configurable by contract). Legal holds take precedence over retention TTLs and will preserve records until released by an authorized legal request." Also: add a brief how-to for requesting a legal hold (contact Sales/Legal via support ticket) and avoid phrasing like "permanent" or "forever."
Priya Shah: adding a short FAQ: "Can I send emails/phones in audit webhooks?" -> "No. Send pseudonym IDs or tokens; contact support for migration help."
Elena Kaur: please also include a concrete export example that demonstrates redaction at export time. SOC2 likes explicit samples.
Priya Shah: curl export example I added:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"2026-01-01","redact_keys":["email","phone","ip","device_location"],"format":"jsonl"}' \
  -o export.json
```
Previewed exported line in docs: `{"event_action":"workspace.create","tenant_id":"t-2026","timestamp":"2026-06-10T15:30:00Z","actor":{"pseudonym_id":"pid-7f8g"},"attributes":{"device_location":"[redacted]","ip":"[redacted]"}}`
Tom Liu: recommend adding a server-side shim example in Go for mapping old keys: `event := payload.Get("event_action"); if event=="" { event = payload.Get("audit_action") }` and add guidance to emit deprecation header for 45 days.
Docs Bot: linkcheck: new section references /docs/evidence-playbook-v3 which 404s on staging.
Priya Shah: thanks bot, I'll switch link to /evidence-playbook and add a redirect note. Also adding a short line to changelog about the key rename + deprecation window.
Legal - Compliance: approve pending the link fix and the export example showing redaction behavior. Please also ensure the Terraform snippet calls out that retention_days is configurable only for Dedicated/Private plans (don't promise self-serve changes for hosted without sales).
Chloe Nguyen: noted, I'll update the snippet and add a parenthetical note: (Available for Dedicated and Private deployments; contact Sales for Hosted changes.)
Priya Shah: I'll push the amended commit in ~15m, tag @Legal - Compliance and @Tom for a final pass. After merge we'll run `npm run linkcheck` and add the PR # to the release notes. Thanks all! :sparkles:
